name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
summary: Hip hinge on one leg; hips back, back straight.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee, dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Push the hips back and tilt the torso forward while the free leg goes back in line with the body.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh, back straight.
Drive the hips forward to stand up.
commonMistakes: Opening the hips to the side.
Bending the standing knee a lot.
breathing: Inhale while hinging, exhale while standing.
easier: Touch a wall for balance or keep the rear toes on the floor.
harder: Add a band under the foot or slow down.

start.alt: Standing on one leg holding a dumbbell.

end.alt: Hinged forward on one leg, free leg extended back in line with the torso.
